thread:
Alex G: Quick sync — I'm packaging a compact Terraform module bundle for CloudCo marketplace. Goal: tiny artifacts, one opinionated starter per cloud, optional examples. Need alignment on input surface, naming, and versioning.
Maria S: +1 on small artifacts. question: do we want provider-agnostic wrappers or one module per provider? naming convention idea: redwood-marketplace-<provider>-starter :thinking:
Samir P: prefer one module per provider. provider-agnostic wrappers add complexity and test surface area. keep core simple, publish a meta repo that pulls modules together.
Kevin T: CI note — we need a matrix for provider versions & terraform core. recommend smoke tests + terraform-compliance for policy checks. can we pin providers in examples?
Alex G: Agree to per-provider modules. Example usage (for AWS starter):
```hcl
module "redwood_aws_starter" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-aws-starter.git//modules/starter?ref=v0.1.0"
  region = "us-west-2"
  VPC_id = var.vpc_id
}
```
Maria S: That source pattern looks good. For naming I'm leaning toward: redwood-marketplace-aws-starter vMAJOR.MINOR semantics. Keep changelog in repo root.
Samir P: Also add a lightweight runtime smoke template (1 GPU small instance, minimal model) so partners can verify latency without large infra. Put it under examples/smoke/ so it's excluded from module root.
Kevin T: CI details: add GitHub Actions matrix: terraform_version: [1.4.6, 1.5.0], provider version pinned in .tf.lock, run init/plan/apply against local azurerm/aws mocks, then run security policies. I'll draft workflow.
deploy-bot: Artifact publish attempt: marketplace-aws-starter v0.1.0 -> s3://redwood-artifacts/marketplace/2461234567. Smoke test failed: aws-iam-policy check failed (missing least-privilege on assume role).
Alex G: Thanks bot — Samir can you take the IAM bit? Might be our example using broad role for speed; tighten it.
Samir P: On it. I'll replace the role with a scoped assume_role and update README. ETA: EOD Wednesday.
Maria S: I'll write the naming + versioning doc and a short onboarding checklist for partners (how to import module, how to run smoke). Will include example of pinned provider versions.
Kevin T: I'll push the GH Action draft to the repo under .github/workflows/ci-marketplace.yml by tomorrow.
Alex G: Action items recap: Samir — IAM + smoke example; Maria — naming & onboarding doc; Kevin — CI matrix. We'll reconvene async; ping me when PRs are ready. :+1:
Kevin T: FYI I'll add a tiny test tag so marketplace automation can surface 'verified-by-redwood' metadata in the published artifact.
Maria S: Nice. Also thinking about a short FAQ for partners about multi-account setups. I'll add that to docs/FAQ.md.
Alex G: Perfect. Thanks team — moving to async updates.
